targetTexts.1: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
targetTexts.2: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.
targetTexts.3: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.
targetTexts.4: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.
targetTexts.5: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!
targetTexts.6: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.
targetTexts.7: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
targetTexts.8: I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me.
targetTexts.9: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
targetTexts.10: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
targetTexts.11: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
targetTexts.12: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
targetTexts.13: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
targetTexts.14: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.
targetTexts.15: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
targetTexts.16: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
targetTexts.17: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
targetTexts.18: Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.
targetTexts.19: I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.
targetTexts.20: My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.
targetTexts.21: You rebuke the arrogant—the cursed who stray from Your commandments.
targetTexts.22: Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.
targetTexts.23: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
targetTexts.24: Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors.
targetTexts.25: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
targetTexts.26: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
targetTexts.27: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
targetTexts.28: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.
targetTexts.29: Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.
targetTexts.30: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.
targetTexts.31: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.
targetTexts.32: I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.
targetTexts.33: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.
targetTexts.34: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
targetTexts.35: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.
targetTexts.36: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.
targetTexts.37: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.
targetTexts.38: Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.
targetTexts.39: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.
targetTexts.40: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness.
targetTexts.41: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.
targetTexts.42: Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.
targetTexts.43: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.
targetTexts.44: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.
targetTexts.45: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.
targetTexts.46: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.
targetTexts.47: I delight in Your commandments because I love them.
targetTexts.48: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes.
targetTexts.49: Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.
targetTexts.50: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.
targetTexts.51: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.
targetTexts.52: I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.
targetTexts.53: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.
targetTexts.54: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.
targetTexts.55: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.
targetTexts.56: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts.
targetTexts.57: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
targetTexts.58: I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.
targetTexts.59: I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.
targetTexts.60: I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.
targetTexts.61: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.
targetTexts.62: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.
targetTexts.63: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.
targetTexts.64: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
targetTexts.65: You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.
targetTexts.66: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.
targetTexts.67: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.
targetTexts.68: You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.
targetTexts.69: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.
targetTexts.70: Their hearts are callous and insensitive, but I delight in Your law.
targetTexts.71: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.
targetTexts.72: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
targetTexts.73: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
targetTexts.74: May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.
targetTexts.75: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
targetTexts.76: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.
targetTexts.77: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.
targetTexts.78: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.
targetTexts.79: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.
targetTexts.80: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
targetTexts.81: My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
targetTexts.82: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”
targetTexts.83: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
targetTexts.84: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?
targetTexts.85: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
targetTexts.86: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!
targetTexts.87: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
targetTexts.88: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth.
targetTexts.89: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
targetTexts.90: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
targetTexts.91: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
targetTexts.92: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
targetTexts.93: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.
targetTexts.94: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
targetTexts.95: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.
targetTexts.96: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit.
targetTexts.97: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
targetTexts.98: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
targetTexts.99: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
targetTexts.100: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
targetTexts.101: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.
targetTexts.102: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
targetTexts.103: How sweet are Your words to my taste—sweeter than honey in my mouth!
targetTexts.104: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.
targetTexts.105: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
targetTexts.106: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
targetTexts.107: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
targetTexts.108: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
targetTexts.109: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.
targetTexts.110: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
targetTexts.111: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
targetTexts.112: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end.
targetTexts.113: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.
targetTexts.114: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
targetTexts.115: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
targetTexts.116: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
targetTexts.117: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
targetTexts.118: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
targetTexts.119: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
targetTexts.120: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments.
targetTexts.121: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
targetTexts.122: Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
targetTexts.123: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
targetTexts.124: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.
targetTexts.125: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
targetTexts.126: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.
targetTexts.127: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.
targetTexts.128: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.
targetTexts.129: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.
targetTexts.130: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.
targetTexts.131: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.
targetTexts.132: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.
targetTexts.133: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
targetTexts.134: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
targetTexts.135: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
targetTexts.136: My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed.
targetTexts.137: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
targetTexts.138: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.
targetTexts.139: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.
targetTexts.140: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.
targetTexts.141: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.
targetTexts.142: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.
targetTexts.143: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.
targetTexts.144: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
targetTexts.145: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.
targetTexts.146: I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.
targetTexts.147: I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.
targetTexts.148: My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.
targetTexts.149: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.
targetTexts.150: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.
targetTexts.151: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.
targetTexts.152: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever.
targetTexts.153: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
targetTexts.154: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.
targetTexts.155: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.
targetTexts.156: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.
targetTexts.157: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.
targetTexts.158: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.
targetTexts.159: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.
targetTexts.160: The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever.
targetTexts.161: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.
targetTexts.162: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
targetTexts.163: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.
targetTexts.164: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
targetTexts.165: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.
targetTexts.166: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.
targetTexts.167: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.
targetTexts.168: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.
targetTexts.169: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.
targetTexts.170: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.
targetTexts.171: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
targetTexts.172: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.
targetTexts.173: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
targetTexts.174: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.
targetTexts.175: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.
targetTexts.176: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.
